description: Verify that DUT replies to an ARP Request carrying hw_type=Ethernet (0x0001) — the receiver must accept the standard hardware family (RFC 826 §2.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Positive control for ARP_21 (rejection of unknown hw_type). With the correct Ethernet identifier in hw_type, DUT must reply normally.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ARP Request injected
   • opcode       = 1
   • hw_type      = 0x0001 (Ethernet)   ← correct
   • target_ip    = DUT IP
   • sender_*     = HOST-1-IP / MAC-ADDR1

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: ARP Reply (opcode 2, sender_mac=DUT, target_ip=HOST-1-IP)

[Pass condition]
DUT emits an ARP Reply within the observation window.

[Fail condition]
Fail_no_reply — DUT did not reply, despite hw_type being the standard Ethernet identifier. Suggests reception logic is broken even for the correct value.

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied to a Request with hw_type=Ethernet — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_reply: DUT did not reply even with hw_type=0x0001 — reception logic broken for valid input
